reviewer: TC inventory reviewer; also authored some included test cases
review_scope: Authoring/inventory consistency only. This is not independent source qualification, runner review, pre-gate, execution authorization, or H2 acceptance.

retained_inventory.evidence: The integrated 407 retained pytest node IDs convert one-for-one, in the same order, to the 407 historical dotted case IDs in h2-runtime-normal-tc-ledger.json; the historical ledger SHA matches its recorded pin.

union_and_phases.evidence: There are 407 retained IDs, 83 unique additional IDs, and 490 unique IDs in the union with no overlap. The six retained phases account for all retained IDs; the nine new phases account for all 83 additions.

approved_obligation_coverage.evidence: The 25 obligation IDs and order match the exact approved plan. The draft inventory assigns literal IDs to all 25 groups, including CRASH-01 through CRASH-12 and all named NEG groups. The five fixture-failure prerequisites are explicitly identified and remain among those approved groups; they do not create a 26th business obligation.

case_fields.evidence: All 83 new-case records and all 15 retained/additional phase records contain every required field.

phase_case_and_budget_mapping.evidence: Each additional phase's node_ids exactly match its per_case_budgets keys. The literal CASE_NODE_IDS in dispatcher, startup, activity/runtime, transport, workspace and fixture-failure watchdog plugins match the phase IDs. The worker API plugin's CASE_FILES keys match its four phase IDs; its filename values are private journal names. The started/deployment plugin composes the nine listed parametrized variants and the separate foreign-deployment ID. Window and startup parametrized IDs match their literal base/variant definitions. Phase deadlines equal the sum of listed per-case setup/body plus shared-cleanup budgets with the documented 60-second phase allowance.

budget_totals.evidence: The 83 new cases divide exactly into 49 cases at 215+25 seconds and 34 at 25+5 seconds. The sum of the six retained and nine additional phase caps is 15,420 seconds, matching limits.phase_caps_sum_seconds.

source_pins_and_history.evidence: All 84 current source pins and seven derivative-ledger pins match their recorded SHA-256 values. All 14 historical source-pin override rows point to the corresponding historical pins in their derivative ledgers and state that shared-fixture/native-bounds changes mean the historical result does not qualify current bytes. Repeated rows are intentional ledger/source history entries.

scope_and_authority.evidence: The inventory preserves all 407 retained cases and includes all 25 approved groups without a narrowed H2 scope. execution_authorized, runner_authoring_authorized, and full_h2_acceptance are false; all cases are unexecuted and acceptance, collection, runner, and pre-gate work remain pending.

limitations: This review checks inventory structure and authoring metadata, not whether each test source reaches its named runtime cut or whether a product invariant passes.
The reviewer authored some included test cases, so this report is not independent source-method review. The separate senior source review remains necessary.
No imports, pytest collection, tests, SQL, services, or network operations were run. Static node-ID construction checks do not substitute for the exact future collection gate.

The NEG-WINDOW isolated exact-deadline clock seam remains subject to the approved-plan caveat and its pending independent source review; the separately listed real-runtime before/after cases remain required.

authority.next_gate: Complete independent source review, exact execution-contract review, runner review, and pre-gate before any authorized execution.
